methodology.timing: Process wall in measurements; library wall excluding TPC-H pool initialization in library_measurements. Library timing includes table/session/job creation, worker startup/join, generation and batch consumption.
methodology.cpu_and_rss: Whole fresh process, including setup. Ordered Populate consumers run on the calling thread; reference partitions consume/drop on their workers. Reference comparisons therefore include delivery-semantics differences; before/after comparisons keep the ordered API.
methodology.output: Full Arrow RecordBatches are generated and consumed; no IPC encoding, file output, disk flushing or cache drops.
methodology.scale: SF10 generation only. SF1/SF100 and profiles were not rerun on this revision; historical results remain pinned to their recorded commits.
methodology.batch_defaults: Populate TPC-H/SSB 8192, TPC-DS/DSB 2048, Rust references 8000; all batch/chunk overrides zero.
methodology.reference: Rust tpchgen/tpchgen-arrow and tpcdsgen/tpcdsgen-arrow 4.0.0. Reference tables use up to the requested number of source partitions, including small TPC-DS tables.
methodology.aggregate: Selected tables follow TableName::ALL unless explicitly listed. The multi-thread reference adapter pops table/partition jobs from a shared Vec in LIFO order. Populate schedules remaining work per source and fuses compatible TPC-DS sales/returns. Aggregate speedups include scheduling and fusion differences; aggregate times cannot be obtained by adding isolated table times.
methodology.controls: stream consumes/drops each batch on its worker; TPC-DS stream is unfused. Do not attribute an ordered-fused versus stream-unfused difference solely to buffering.
methodology.sampling: Seven measured fresh-process trials after one excluded warmup; baseline/candidate order alternates. No timings overlap builds, tests, full-output hashing, or profiling.
methodology.source: Candidate is rebased directly onto main 5c5cd1b5, retaining the columns-only Distribution API. The only rebase conflict was a test import, resolved by keeping flat_map and adding named.
